description: This file contains cryptographic functions and macros for ZIP file encryption/decryption, including key initialization, byte decryption, key updating, and crypt header generation. It implements traditional PKWARE encryption and related utilities.

methods.name: decrypt_byte
methods.description: Returns the next byte in the pseudo-random sequence used for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: update_keys
methods.description: Updates encryption keys with a new byte of plaintext, modifying the key state.

methods.name: init_keys
methods.description: Initializes encryption keys based on a password and a CRC table.

methods.name: crypthead
methods.description: Generates an encrypted header for ZIP encryption, using a password, CRC, and random data.
